title: Off-display / low-likelihood confirm
preconditions: Self-contained. Prefer winter/shoulder visit date for low likelihood, or enable **Include off-display animals**. If impossible from seed alone: Blocked → CON-01.

steps.name: Include off-display
steps.do: Enable **Include off-display animals** if testing off-display.

steps.name: Select target animal
steps.do: Select an off-display or very low-likelihood animal.
steps.expect: Confirm dialog appears (off-display or below-threshold likelihood message).

steps.name: Finish
steps.do: Finish itinerary with that animal included.

steps.name: List cue
steps.do: Inspect list for status/likelihood cue if any.

steps.name: Document Blocked path
steps.do: If no such animal existed for the date, mark suite Blocked.
steps.expect: Notes point to CON-01 or alternate date.
